newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sports Authority cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sports Authority cut.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros analyst William Julian said in a research note that he lowered his recommendation on Sports Authority Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- Shares slipped 3/4 to 26-1/4 in early New York Stock Exchange trade.
-- The downgrade was based on the stock reaching a price target of $26 per share "and is valued at levels equal to historical highs, potentially discounting positive news in the near-term."
-- Also, "The improvement in gross margin prompted by a (product) mix shift favoring apparel and footware is largely finished ... (and) ... sales productivity continues to moderate."
